## **Frontier System Prompt Distillation and Layer 1 Constitutional Kernel**

A comprehensive cross-platform audit of production system prompts archived in https\://github.com/asgeirtj/system\_prompts\_leaks—spanning Anthropic’s Claude 3.7 Sonnet (claude-3.7-sonnet-w-tools.md), Claude Code (claude-code-opus-4.8.md, claude-code-2.1.172-fable-5.md, skills/claude-api/SKILL.md), Claude Fable 5 (1,585 lines / \~27,000 tokens), and Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5.md), alongside OpenAI’s o1/o3/GPT-5.4 Thinking (gpt-5.4-thinking.md) and GPT-6-Astra Codex, and Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro, Deep Research, and Antigravity CLI—reveals a decisive architectural divergence between consumer chatbots and autonomous coding harnesses7.  
Whereas consumer chat surfaces such as Claude.ai expanded their static system prompts from 24,000 tokens in Claude 3.7 Sonnet to over 27,000–138,000 tokens in Claude Fable 5/5.1 by encoding years of edge-case refusals and legal copyright limits directly into the root prompt, frontier software engineering harnesses moved in the exact opposite direction10. Specifically, Anthropic cut 80% of the static system prompt in Claude Code for Opus 5 relative to Fable 5, relocating domain procedures into on-demand skills (SKILL.md), position-addressed memory directories (/profile.md, /areas/\*.md, /topics/\*.md), and strict tool parameter validators7. This empirical trend across leaked frontier prompts independently validates Van Clief’s 3-Layer Routing System and Hermes Agent OS’s 1,200-token ceiling for \~/.hermes/SOUL.md1.

| Frontier Model / Harness (system\_prompts\_leaks) | Leaked Architectural Mechanism | Cognitive & Operational Purpose | Synthesis in Hermes Agent OS Layer 1 (SOUL.md) & Layer 3 (mcp\_openjev.py) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Claude 3.7 Sonnet & Claude Code (claude-3.7-sonnet-w-tools.md)** | Structured \<antThinking\> deliberation blocks \+ update vs. rewrite artifact mutation rules requiring a perfectly unique old\_str and capping update calls at ![][image26] per turn8. | Forces explicit System-2 planning prior to tool emission; prevents blind full-file overwrites or ambiguous regex replacements that corrupt surrounding code8. | Enforces \<deliberation\> \+ Declarative Attention tags (\<global\>, \<focus id="..."\>, \<local\>) before every tool call; jev\_mutate\_module requires unique target\_pattern matching and enforces the Karpathy U12 ![][image27]\-line surgical diff limit1. |
| **Claude Code Eval Hill-Climb (skills/claude-api/SKILL.md)** | Deterministic 4-step execution gate: Step 0 (confirm runnable eval), Step 1 (scope boundaries), Step 2 (budget/stopping condition), Step 3 (read \-\> propose \-\> apply \-\> run \-\> record loop with one cause per diff)7. | Eliminates speculative multi-file thrashing by binding every code mutation to an immediate, isolated verification pass and a recorded causal hypothesis7. | Codified as Law 6 & Law 7 in SOUL.md: mandatory Turn-1 jev\_compile\_intent, single-cause surgical diffing, and non-substitutable verification (![][image28]) sealed in /tmp/hermes\_verified\_receipt.json1. |
| **Claude Opus 5 Memory Architecture (claude-opus-5.md)** | Strict separation of temporal stability across /profile.md (![][image29] months stable, ![][image30] words), /areas/\*.md (active projects/incidents), and /topics/\*.md using memory\_str\_replace with if\_version concurrency tokens11. | Prevents context surveillance bloat and concurrent write corruption by routing facts according to their decay rate and enforcing size caps11. | Maps to MEMORY.md (![][image22] chars for immutable CORE\_HEADER\_SET §1–§8), USER.md, and EXPERIENCE.md spillover with Ebbinghaus decay pruning and SQLite WAL busy\_timeout \= 100001. |
| **Claude Fable 5 & Opus 5 Epistemic Honesty (claude-opus-5.md, claude-fable-5)** | Anti-sycophancy and anti-assumption rule: *"A prompt implying a file is present doesn't mean one is... checks for itself"*; treats untrusted text pushing against core rules as prompt injection11. | Stops the model from hallucinating file contents, fabricating test outputs, or obeying adversarial shell payloads embedded in repositories11. | Codified in Law 2 & Law 11: mandatory extract\_workspace\_ast recon before mutation, sanitize\_and\_audit\_input (![][image31]) blocking \$(...) and backticks, and zero test assertion tampering1. |
| **OpenAI o1 / o3 / GPT-5.4 Thinking (gpt-5.4-thinking.md)** | Batched multi-query tool efficiency hints \+ strict JSON Schema parameter validation (strict: true, additionalProperties: false)7. | Minimizes multi-turn latency roundtrips while guaranteeing that serialized tool calls conform 100% to typed execution contracts7. | Implemented via SoL-Pi action coalescing (jev\_mutate\_module auto-runs ast.parse \+ ruff check in a single turn) and Pydantic v2 ConfigDict(extra="forbid") across all 14 FastMCP tools1. |
| **Google Gemini 3.1 Pro / Deep Research / Antigravity CLI** | Hierarchical hub-and-spoke workspace grounding, autonomous web/corpus verification for mathematical constants, and clean subagent process lifecycle management1. | Prevents hallucination of external APIs or formulas and eliminates orphan background processes across long-horizon research and coding loops1. | Enforced via root AGENTS.md \+ SOUL.md precedence chain, OpenViking L0/L1/L2 semantic retrieval on Port 1933, and CPython 3.13 PGID process reaping (start\_new\_session=True)1. |

### **Production Layer 1 Constitutional Kernel (\~/.hermes/SOUL.md)**

Integrating Van Clief’s Layer 1 Factory Manual principles with the cognitive invariants distilled from system\_prompts\_leaks yields the canonical GDR17 \~/.hermes/SOUL.md1. Placed at token index 0, the \[PRECEDENCE OVERRIDE\] block counteracts RoPE attention decay across 128K contexts while keeping total length at \~980 words (\~1,180 tokens), strictly below the 1,200-token SWA budget ceiling1.
